kind_of_thing.quote: Zebras are mammals of the family Equidae.

kind_of_animal.quote: Zebras are mammals of the family Equidae.

extinct.quote: There are three living species: Grévy's zebra (Equus grevyi), the plains zebra (E. quagga), and the mountain zebra (E. zebra).

pet_farm_or_wild.quote: Zebras inhabit eastern and southern Africa and can be found in a variety of habitats such as savannahs, grasslands, woodlands, shrublands, and mountainous areas.

what_it_eats.quote: Zebras are primarily grazers and can subsist on lower-quality vegetation.
